name: film-atlanta-heist
text: I'm releasing an American crime thriller in about 4 months. It follows a bank clerk in Atlanta who gets pulled into a heist she can't walk away from. We want to open in Atlanta, New York and London, mainly for men aged 25 to 34, with around $40k to spend. It's in the world of Widows and Baby Driver.
title: Salt Road

name: music-rnb-tour
text: I'm an R&B artist putting out a new album in 10 weeks. We're touring Atlanta, New York, Los Angeles and London, in that order, for fans aged 18 to 24. SZA, Summer Walker and Brent Faiyaz are the closest in sound.
title: Night Songs

name: music-indie-folk
text: I'm an indie folk singer-songwriter from Manchester releasing my debut EP in the spring. I play small venues in Manchester, Leeds and Dublin, mostly for people in their late 20s and 30s.
title: Quiet Hours

name: books-how-to-be-a-man
text: Hey, I just wrote a book titled "How to be a man". It's about motivation, rules and etiquette for the move from boyhood to manhood. I want to launch it in the US first, then the UK, but I don't know how to go about it.

name: books-romantasy-debut
text: My debut romantasy novel comes out in 5 months. I'm launching in London and New York. It's for readers of Fourth Wing and A Court of Thorns and Roses.
title: Ashes of the Crown

name: podcast-true-crime-canada
text: I'm starting a weekly true crime podcast called "Cold Trails" about unsolved cases in Canada. It launches in 6 weeks and I'm in Toronto, with listeners in Vancouver too.
title: Cold Trails

name: game-cozy-farming
text: Our small studio is releasing a cozy farming game for Switch and PC next spring. Our players are mostly women aged 25 to 40. We're based in Montreal.
title: Little Orchard

name: shows-comedy-mumbai
text: I'm promoting a stand-up comedy night in Mumbai on 2027-03-12 for people aged 25 to 34. The room holds 500.
title: The Late Laugh

name: film-audit-flawed-plan
text: Our plan for a Nigerian crime thriller: open in Lagos in December for ages 18 to 24, with Verve as the payment partner and a Tier A beverage sponsor. We expect 500k views in week one. Black Panther is our only comp.
title: Salt Road
